fusions.name: Relay Sting
fusions.desc: Sends a stinger drone that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then flies on to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each for 40% of that damage.

fusions.name: Emptied Racks
fusions.desc: Launches a rack of drones outward, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hive Fabricator
fusions.desc: Sets down a fabricator that builds drones for 12 seconds. The swarm deals 3 damage every second to an enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Shift Rotation
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
